# Philips N4520 Player v0.0.18

## Changes

- Schedules Sendspin VU frames from `chunk.serverTimeUs` using Sendspin's synchronized server-to-client time filter.
- Keeps `sendspin_vu_offset_ms` as a final manual correction after server-time scheduling.
- Falls back to websocket arrival-time scheduling only while Sendspin time sync is not available.
- Sorts queued Sendspin VU frames by display timestamp before playback.
- Clears queued VU frames on Sendspin stream clear/end to prevent stale meter motion after pause or track changes.
- Adds `sendspin_debug` for timing diagnostics in the card status line.
- Documents how to use unique Sendspin target IDs for multiple independent deck cards.

## Notes

Enable this while tuning:

```yaml
sendspin_debug: true
```

The status line will show whether the card is using `server` or `arrival`
timing, the Sendspin sync state, sample rate, chunk/window duration, queue
depth, late frames, effective lead time, and Sendspin time-sync error.
